requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 6,00,00,000 during the last three financial years.
The bidder shall remit an EMD of Rs. 12,00,000 online or furnish a bank guarantee valid for 120 days.
The bidder shall have at least 5 years of experience executing rural water supply schemes.
MSEs registered under Udyam are exempted from the EMD on production of a valid certificate.
The bidder shall be registered as a Class I contractor with the Tamil Nadu Public Works Department.
9.1 The contractor shall lay 96 kilometres of distribution mains and construct four overhead tanks.
9.2 The contractor shall complete the entire scheme within 24 months from the date of agreement.
9.3 The contractor must use pipes bearing an ISI mark and produce test certificates for every consignment.
9.4 The contractor shall restore all road cuttings to the satisfaction of the concerned local body.
9.5 The contractor shall maintain the scheme for a defect liability period of 24 months after completion.
9.6 The contractor should engage local labour to the extent available at the work site.
All documents shall be uploaded in PDF format; each file shall not exceed 10 MB.
Bids shall be uploaded on the Tamil Nadu tenders portal before 03:00 PM IST on 27-11-2026.
The technical and price covers shall be digitally signed with a Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate.
The bidder shall upload the PWD registration certificate, the PAN card and the GST registration.
Price covers of technically qualified bidders alone will be opened and the lowest quote accepted.
The board will verify completion certificates for at least two rural water supply schemes of similar value.
